## 03 · AI Email Responder
Watches the inbox, classifies each unread email, auto-replies to routine ones and escalates sensitive ones to Slack.

**Trigger:** new unread Gmail message (polls every minute)

**Setup**
1. Edit the **Config** node (model, sheet URL, endpoints).
2. Connect credentials: Gmail OAuth2, OpenAI API, Slack.
3. Pick Slack channels / sheet tabs on the action nodes.
4. Activate.
